# P34.33 — Round-close record checks (G9 + capstone two-sum + tail probe-sweep contract)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-ENG-041** (`Also:` — the capstone two-sum check; owner SEED-15,
this row extends it) · **SIG-ENG-031** (cited — the amended phase gate this row checks)
· **SIG-MEM-011** (cited — probe-run records; owner P35.3) · B4 **G9** + **G7 item 5** +
**G10 tail column** · **Base:** `r11/P34.32-adr-index-generator-and-trigger-register`
(stacked; merge after P34.32) · **Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/238_P34.33__round-close-record-checks.md` (manifest row 238 — Round 11 /
P34, sub-round 11A; depends P34.32, SEED-15) · **Gate:** none · **Live stage:** none
(`live_verification=false`) · **Production mutations:** none · **OM-20:** not an OM-20
row · **CI config changed: yes** — the structure-mode check joins `make docs-check`
(`docs-check-round-close`) and the CI `docs` job gains a named step
(`Round-close record checks (check_round_close.py)`), both calling the same stdlib
tool. The `--round-tail` mode is a CLI flag the tail rows (P34.47, P35.64, P36.73, P38)
call — not a CI stage.

## Why

A round cannot close on records that were never kept. The amended SIG-ENG-031 (B4 G9)
requires at each round close: a dated risk-register round review, unique risk ids, every
deferred risk routed to a backlog home, and every manifest `### Round` banner tied to a
spec part. The replays are real: RISK-P21-03 sat unrouted when its home closed; RISK-P5-04
and RISK-P20-01 each head two rows; Rounds 2–9's banners predate the rule (F-32 §52).
The capstone headline needs two sums, not one — ACCEPT-R10's "34 MET" folded the
MET-ENGINEERED leg into MET (superseded by C-13; the SIG-ENG-041 vocabulary).
And G10's tail column needs a *written* probe-sweep contract the sub-round acceptance
rows and P38 can consume — the probes themselves are their owners' (P35.3 / OPS rows).

## What this ships

- **`docs/build/tools/check_round_close.py` (new, stdlib)** — one checker, two modes:
  - *structure mode* (`check`, in `make docs-check`): RISK ids unique — a duplicate
    resolves only through an appended `Renamed RISK-…a by this record` inside a **dated**
    `## Round N review` section (never a renamed row; the two live duplicates RISK-P5-04 /
    RISK-P20-01 already carry dated rename records in the Round-11 review); every
    deferred-class RISK row *routed* — backlog `sources` ownership, an id-cell `→ BL-nnn`
    cite, or a corrections-table record — with every named BL existing, a re-home
    (cite ≠ owner) requiring the appended corrections record, and a
    `Re-homed … → BL-nnn` target required open; every chain `### Round N` banner that
    opens a chain table cites an existing spec part/section (Round 11 → `Part XII`,
    `§56`; Rounds 2–9 exempt, listed); the appended `Frozen historical view` pointers on
    `docs/traceability.md` and `docs/build/TICKET_VS_SPEC.md`; and the capstone two-sum
    (below).
  - *tail mode* (`check --round-tail <YYYY-MM-DD>`): the register's `## Round N review`
    for the LEDGER's `round:` dated at-or-after the round start; `adr_triggers.py check
    --round-tail` — P34.32's tail mode this row *calls*, never re-implements; and the
    probe sweep: every probe in `tail_probe_sweep.toml` needs a committed `sig.probe-run/1`
    record ≤ 24 h old at `--at` (the packet commit) that evaluated something — an empty
    `checks` map or an all-`skipped` record fails (G11).
- **`docs/build/tools/record_policy/round_close.toml` (new)** — the G9/G7-item-5 policy:
  banner exemption list + required cites, the two-sum packet path patterns, and the
  exempt-by-date-listed historical packets (ACCEPT-R8, GATE-ACCEPT, ACCEPT-R10,
  CAPSTONE_CLOSURE, CAPSTONE_GAP_ANALYSIS — each exemption verified non-vacuous).
- **The capstone two-sum check (G7 item 5).** A packet whose headline carries a bare
  `<count> <verdict>` claim must declare
  `coverage two-sum[<layer>]: engineering closed = N · requirement satisfied = M`,
  recomputed from `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` via `check_coverage_matrix`'s verdict parser —
  engineering closed = MET + MET-DIFFERENTLY + MET-ENGINEERED, requirement satisfied =
  MET + MET-DIFFERENTLY — per status layer (`achieved_domain`). Every bare claim is
  verified against the matrix count, so a folded count ("4 MET" for MET + MET-ENGINEERED)
  or a stale one fails. The patterns include `docs/build/readouts/GATE-*.md` so the
  Round-11 sub-round acceptance packets (P34.47 / P35.64 / P36.73 / P38) are in scope —
  a deliberate widening of the contract's `GATE-ACCEPT*.md` (ADR-199 D4).
- **`docs/build/tools/record_policy/tail_probe_sweep.toml` (new)** — the written G10 tail
  contract: the ten probes (route allow-list/absence, release record and id on pages,
  attribution sanity, jurisdiction–coordinate consistency, API-vs-release parity, number
  truth, monitoring liveness, live-config drift, fixture-sentinel scan, claim markers),
  each with `requires` (B4's own citations), `owner`, the producer `command` the owner
  ships, and the committed `sig.probe-run/1` record path under
  `docs/build/reports/probes/`.
- **Record edits:** the nine Round-11 chain banners gain `· spec: Part XII (§56)`; the
  risk register gains one appended corrections row (RISK-P18-04 re-homed BL-042 → BL-087
  — the re-home BL-042's residue line already recorded; the corrections record makes the
  routing explicit); `traceability.md` and `TICKET_VS_SPEC.md` gain the appended
  frozen-view pointers.
- **ADR-199** — the owned decisions record (one checker/two modes; the "routed, not
  re-verdicted" deferred semantics; the exemption lists; the two-sum grammar; the TOML
  sweep contract; vacuous-is-red) — plus its Appendix F row (spec_src + BUILD.sh), its
  BL-084 sources/title entry, and its ADR_TRIGGERS register row (quiet at authoring).
- **25 fixture tests** (`test_check_round_close.py`) — tmp_path fixture trees, no
  living-record pins (OM-15); one real-tree validator call.

`memory_guard.py all --staged` — 0 violations · `make ci-local` — the Docker legs
(`SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1` e2e, the pinned sqitch image) cannot run locally; recorded as

armed; npm legs deferred to CI)`.

## Deferrals

None opened, none closed — no owed DEFERRALS row scopes to this surface.

## Deviations

- **Packet pattern widening (recorded):** the contract names `GATE-ACCEPT*.md`; the
  declared pattern is `docs/build/readouts/GATE-*.md` so the Round-11 sub-round
  acceptance packets the contract also names (P34.47 / P35.64 / P36.73 / P38) land in
  scope — ADR-199 decision 4.
- **`docker` legs not run locally:** the daemon is wedged (not ticket-caused); the
  fail-fast stub only made the Python suite complete — the `docker`/`SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS`
  legs of `make ci-local` need a live daemon, recorded `locally-green` per H2 §3.4.

## Out of scope honoured

No tail run (P38's), no trigger-register re-implementation (P34.32's mode is *called*),
no verdict-vocabulary change (SEED-15's), no probes built (P35.3/OPS), no gate ticks,
no source flips, no production mutation, no OM-20.
